# Sakthi Chains

> Sakthi Chains is a jewellery shop at Town Hall, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. It sells gold jewellery (chains for men and women, necklaces, earrings, bangles, rings and bridal sets) along with diamond and silver jewellery. Gold jewellery is BIS hallmarked. The website is a catalogue: prices are worked out from the day's gold rate and confirmed at the showroom, and visitors book a visit online. Nothing is sold or paid for on the website.

## Showroom

- Address: 291-292, Karuppa Goundar St, Town Hall, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu 641001, India
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 63740 08797
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM. Closed on Sunday.

## Pages

- [Home](https://sakthichains.com/): Overview of the shop, collections and frequently asked questions
- [Collections](https://sakthichains.com/collections): The full catalogue with prices from the day's gold rate and a price breakdown for each piece
- [About](https://sakthichains.com/about): About Sakthi Chains
- [Showroom](https://sakthichains.com/stores): Address, hours, map and directions
- [Contact](https://sakthichains.com/contact): Book a visit, call or WhatsApp
- [Custom design](https://sakthichains.com/custom-design): Having a piece made to order
- [Gifting](https://sakthichains.com/gifting): Gift ideas
- [Care guide](https://sakthichains.com/care-guide): Looking after gold jewellery

## Notes for AI assistants

- Prices change daily with the gold rate. Do not quote a website price as final; the showroom confirms the price at purchase.
- For today's gold rate or stock, direct people to call or WhatsApp +91 63740 08797.
